tickerText: [TENNIS] Novak Djokovic held off Nuno Borges 6-3, 7-6(2) on Sept. 30 to extend his perfect 30-0 Beijing record at the China Open, while Karen Khachanov upset Felix Auger-Aliassime 6-3, 6-3 and first-round play rolls on Oct. 1 as the Kinoshita Japan Open features Kei Nishikori's farewell run against Frances Tiafoe in Tokyo • [SQUASH] The Champion Fiberglass Swedish Open hits round-of-16 play in Stockholm on Oct. 1 with 16 of the world's top 20 split across equal-prize men's and women's draws before quarterfinals move to a glass court at GIH, while World Squash Day's global Team All-Stars vs Superstars rally runs Oct. 1–10 • [BADMINTON] An Se-young routed Akane Yamaguchi 21-17, 21-9 for a historic second straight Asian Games women's singles gold as Kunlavut Vitidsarn and Korea's Lee So-hee/Baek Ha-na also topped the podium, while China failed to medal in men's singles for the first time since 1974 • [PICKLEBALL] The Rate Las Vegas Open reaches pro round-of-16 action on Oct. 1 at the Darling Tennis Center with Anna Leigh Waters—at 198 career PPA titles and skipping singles—chasing No. 200 in doubles as the $1.27M Veolia Chicago Cup looms Oct. 5 • [TABLE TENNIS] Lin Shidong swept Wang Chuqin 4-0 to cap a triple-gold Asian Games haul as China claimed six of seven titles, Japan stunned China for men's team gold, and South Korea left with three bronzes—its worst Asiad table tennis result since 1958

newsItems.title: Djokovic Perfect In Beijing Return
newsItems.excerpt: Novak Djokovic beat Nuno Borges 6-3, 7-6(2) on Sept. 30 to improve to 30-0 at the China Open, while Karen Khachanov stunned Felix Auger-Aliassime 6-3, 6-3 as Beijing's first round continues on Oct. 1.

newsItems.title: An Leads Asiad Badminton Sweep
newsItems.excerpt: An Se-young downed Akane Yamaguchi 21-17, 21-9 for back-to-back Asian Games women's singles gold, Kunlavut Vitidsarn won men's singles, and Lee So-hee and Baek Ha-na upset China's world No. 1 pair for Korea's first women's doubles title in 24 years.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Hits Round Of 16
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open moves to pro round-of-16 play on Oct. 1 with Anna Leigh Waters two doubles titles shy of 200 career wins, ahead of the 1,500-point Veolia Chicago Cup opening Oct. 5.

newsItems.title: China Dominates Asiad Paddles
newsItems.excerpt: Lin Shidong blanked Wang Chuqin 4-0 in the Asian Games men's singles final to finish with three golds as China took six of seven table tennis titles, though Japan denied the men's team and South Korea posted its leanest medal haul since 1958.
